text:
maya: Heads up — ACME (acct 8932) just flagged their March invoice. The compute line for reserved capacity is missing entirely; total also looks lower than expected. attaching the invoice #INV-2026-0312 (pdf) they sent.
oliver: ugh. any error IDs from the invoice job? @eng-billing-bot can you pull logs for invoice run `2026-03-12-8932`?
eng-billing-bot: invoice-gen job 2026-03-12-8932 started at 2026-03-12T02:14Z, completed with warnings. Warning: "usage_line_merge:3" - duplicate usage grouping, skipping line for sku:reserved-gpu-8x.
danielle: that warning sounds like our dedupe logic kicked in incorrectly. last week we changed grouping rules for reserved SKUs.
maya: customer reports two different PDFs: one with missing compute line, one that looks complete. they received duplicate invoices where one had the compute charge and a higher total. they want a single corrected invoice and a credit for the duplicate.
sophia: can we confirm if the duplicate is a reissue or separate invoice id? invoice numbers?
maya: they gave both numbers: INV-2026-0312 and INV-2026-0312-1 (the latter has the compute line).
oliver: hmm so a reissue suffix got generated but our accounting logic treated them as separate charges. we should avoid creating new invoice IDs that the billing system treats as billable until cleanup.
danielle: quick check: the merge key uses (account, sku, day, volume_bucket). After the rule change we started normalizing sku tokens which changed the merge key for reserved-gpu-8x -> reserved_gpu_8x. Looks like the second run created a separate line instead of merging.
sophia: action items: 1) run a targeted regen for account 8932 with the pre-change merge rules to produce a single canonical invoice; 2) mark INV-2026-0312 as void and reissue INV-2026-0312-CORR; 3) ensure any duplicate charge is credited immediately.
maya: customer asked for ETA; they need this settled before end of day PST. can finance expedite a credit hold?
oliver: I'll approve an emergency credit hold. @finance-bot can you create a credit memo placeholder for acct 8932 with reference to both invoice ids and flag it urgent?
finance-bot: created credit-memo CM-2026-0893 (placeholder) for acct 8932. Status: pending-approval. Approver: oliver.
oliver: approved. please attach analyst note: "duplicate invoice generation due to merge-key normalization; credit pending issuance after regen."
danielle: I'll push a hotfix to use the stable sku canonicalization for regen and run the invoice-gen in dry-run first, posting the CSV here.
sophia: if dry-run looks good, we'll void the bad invoice and push the corrected one. also add a regression test so future normalization changes fail the billing smoke test.
maya: customer confirmation: they asked we send a signed correction and show the credit on their portal. also asked how to avoid this in future — can we include a short explanation in the correction email?
oliver: yes — use the standard template + a 2-sentence explanation: "Duplicate invoice created during an internal invoice regeneration; we've voided the duplicate and issued a correction and credit." keep it concise.
danielle: dry-run done: CSV shows one compute line for reserved-gpu-8x with 720 hours and $14,400. totals now match the customer's expected amount.
maya: forwarding to ACME now. thanks team.
finance-bot: final status update: INV-2026-0312 voided, INV-2026-0312-CORR issued, credit memo CM-2026-0893 applied. Customer portal updated.
sophia: please note root cause for postmortem: sku normalization change to merge-key logic. escalating to eng-platform for a rollback-safe migration strategy.
oliver: noted. will coordinate the customer follow-up and file for reimbursement of the emergency credit from product ops. :thumbsup:
maya: closing loop — ACME confirmed they received corrected invoice and portal shows the credit. thanks everyone.
